verdict.rationale: Vercel documents a public REST API at api.vercel.com with versioned endpoints, token authentication, rate-limit headers and an SDK. A live OpenAPI description confirms it, and llms.txt and the ai-catalog explicitly direct agents to read the OpenAPI spec before making REST calls. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of driving the product end to end through the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Interact programmatically with your Vercel account using the SDK or direct HTTP requests.
Vercel access tokens authenticate requests to the Vercel REST API and the Vercel CLI on your behalf.
All endpoints live under the URL https://api.vercel.com and follow the REST architecture.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://vercel.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
For REST API calls, read the OpenAPI description and authentication documentation before choosing an operation.
